relationship: Powering the computer and opening an application connects boot stages and software layers to the target application's operation.

learnerLoop.action: Choose a target application, power on and interact with the displayed software stack.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The boot and application state advance through the represented layers.
learnerLoop.evidence: The screen, stack list, hardware base and status reveal the active layer relationship.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Identify the layer needed for the selected application to work.

invariants: The visible stack describes the current boot and application state.
Application behaviour is presented through the represented software layers.
safeAdaptations: Change target applications, boot stories or explanatory labels while preserving the layer-to-operation relationship.
nonGoals: Booting or controlling the learner's actual computer.

task.description: Build a bootable platform and open one of six target applications.
task.visibility: Present in the corresponding simulation or construction state.

parts.description: Software layers and function cards share the same SVG icons in the bank, drag image and placed stack.
parts.visibility: Present in the corresponding simulation or construction state.

model.description: Preserved monitor and tower above the ordered software stack; power tests it.
model.visibility: Present in the corresponding simulation or construction state.

evidence.description: Selected/locked state and staged boot diagnostics, desktop or application result.
evidence.visibility: Present in the corresponding simulation or construction state.

layers.domain: Selected bank layers and applications; firmware at the base, OS above it, utilities between OS and applications.
layers.output: Nested stack and staged boot result.

functions.description: Functions assigned inside OS or utility layers.
functions.source: Cards placed inside the chosen layer.
functions.output: Boot diagnostics or successful application launch.

modes.target: Image Editor, Word Processor, Web Browser, Spreadsheet, Presentation Software or Media Player.
modes.power: Power off permits editing; power on tests and locks construction.
modes.support: No Working or exam toggle; successful launch reveals the software categories.

dependencies: Bank, preview and placed parts reuse iconSVG.
Boot checks layer order, OS functions, utilities and target application in sequence.
Power off before changing a tested stack; Reset clears and reshuffles the construction.
implementation.completion: A successful boot and target application launch reveals the software categories.
limitations: Diagnostic failures are deterministic teaching cases, including simplified outcomes for missing utility functions.
This is a conceptual boot/dependency model rather than an executable operating system.
